global_listen_ips.description: IP addresses or hostnames to bind the iSCSI target to. Leave empty to use default (0.0.0.0).

global_listen_port.description: TCP port on which the iSCSI target listens. Standard iSCSI port is 3260.

global_node_system_name.description: System name used in iSCSI discovery responses and connection negotiation.

global_auth_method.description: Authentication methods to advertise/support. Common values: 'None', 'CHAP', 'Mutual'.

global_auth_file.description: Path to the authentication file containing CHAP credentials.

global_max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous iSCSI connections per target.

log_file.description: Path to write logs. Leave blank to log to stdout/stderr.

storage_units.description: List of storage units (backing stores) that become LUNs. Each maps to one physical/logical storage.

name.description: Unique name for the storage unit (used in Unit:... section header).

type.description: Type of storage backend: FileIo (file-backed), BlockIo (device), or Memory (RAM disk).

path.description: File path (for FileIo), block device (e.g., /dev/sdX), or memory size (e.g., '128M' for Memory).

blocksize.description: Block size in bytes. Use 512 for compatibility; 4096 for advanced format devices.

blocks.description: Number of blocks (e.g., '1048576'), required for BlockIo/Memory. Omit to auto-detect for FileIo.

write_cache.description: Enable write-back caching? Use false for safety; true may improve performance (risky without power loss protection).

lun_map.description: List of Target:LUN pairs to assign this unit to. Example: ['Target1:0', 'Target2:1'].

targets.description: List of iSCSI targets (IQNs) and their access policies.

name.description: Target name (used in section header [Target:...]). Will be advertised as iqn.yyyy-mm....

auth_type.description: Authentication method: Auto (negotiate), None (no auth), CHAP, or Mutual (two-way CHAP).

allowed_initiators.description: List of allowed initiator IPs, networks (CIDR), or IQNs. Restrict for security.

deny_initiators.description: List of IPs/IQNs explicitly denied access. Takes precedence over allowed.

storage_mappings.description: Per-target LUN mappings when not declared in storage units. Needed if units use dynamic LUN allocation.

target.description: Target name (must match a Target section).

lun_map.description: Unit name → LUN assignment per target.

unit.description: Name of a defined storage unit (from [Unit:...]).

lun.description: LUN ID (0–255). Must be unique per target.

auth_file_override.description: Override path for auth file. Only change if you move auth.conf elsewhere.
